newsitem.title: UK: NWE naphtha firmer with crude, reformer demand.
newsitem.headline: NWE naphtha firmer with crude, reformer demand.

text.p: NWE naphtha was firmer on Monday after recent rises in crude futures and amid demand for reforming qualities, traders said.
September swaps were talked around $204/$206 cif NWE, with October around $3.50 in backwardation.
Refiners in western Europe and in Poland were looking for heavy grades but the market was seen tight.
One large petrochemical end-user was covered for the rest of the month but they said paraffinic numbers were not attractive for petrochemical companies at the moment.
